Commentary.Commentary: That concludes the proceedings from this game. The result was a bit harsh for the English side as they could have chased the score. However, it was indeed a deserving performance from the Men in Green as well. We have another game lined-up as New Zealand and Afghanistan get ready to lock horns. The toss has been delayed for that game, you can swith tabs and enjoy the coverage of that game. Cheers!

Andy Balbirnie, the Irish skipper is the Player of the Match for his knock of 62(47). He says that they were disappointed with their batting effort towards the end. Shares that he had said to the team that they need to create chances and take every one of those. Also shares that it was tough initially against the express pace of England. Adds that it was a competitive total which became a winning total eventually. Shares that it is amazing and emotional to play at the MCG in front of friends and family and also to win against one of the tournament favourites. Feels that they need to take this momentum to their next game against Afghanistan. He hopes that they can improve their fielding as they progress in this tournament.

Jos Buttler, the skipper of England says that it's a bit disappointing and they weren't consistent at the start. Adds that they were good in the second half with the ball, they bowled well but the result didn't go their way. Finishes by saying that bowling first was a good decision but it didn't go their way and they will be under some pressure against Australia and they need to play as a group and come out on top.
Time for the Presentation.

Ireland bowlers bowled with lot of penetration and it was Josh Little who started off with a bang getting rid of both English openers. There was good help for the seamers thoughout and Irish stick to their plans and did not let England get off the hook at any point in this game. In the end, rain gods also seemed to be pleased by their effort and made a bit of contribution to this fantastic and important win for Ireland.

Earlier in the day, Ireland got off to a very good start after England sent them into bat. They were looking set for a huge total till the 12th over but a mini collapse meant they had to settle for a smaller total. Wood was the pick of the bowlers for England and bowled with great fire baging three wickets on the way. Ireland still had a decent total at the end of the first half and then made a match out of it by picking wickets at regular intervals with the ball. England were three down inside the powerplay in their pursuit of 158. Dawid Malan and Harry Brook stitched together a decent stand but both departed after getting starts and that put England in more trouble. Moeen Ali though, was looking good in the middle before rain came to spoil the party and it is Ireland who have notched up a famous victory here.

It's all over folks! Ireland win by 5 runs via DLS method! Handshakes all around and England players looks visibly disappointed. England have only themselves to blame here, they kept losing wickets at regular intervals and have to say, the Irish were the more disciplined and were the more hungrier side and have now scripted yet another famous win. The Irish fans in the stands are delighted and England have again been hunted down by the Ireland on the big stage after that famous win 11 years ago in the 2011 World Cup.

Oh, it has started to rain here at the 'G'! England are 5 behind the DLS par score and the players are going off the field now. It's been a thrilling game so far but it is raining quite heavily now! The covers are on and these are anxious moments for England and their fans. Nasser Hussain, the on-air commentator says that they have 10 mintues to start the game, otherwise we will be done with this game and Ireland will bag those two crucial points against their more fancied neighbours. Remember, the cut-off time to start the game is 1.26 pm IST (7.56 am GMT).
FOUR! Another one outside off, Moeen Ali lofts it over extra covers for a boundary. Excellent shot from Moeen Ali!
Bowls it outside off again, Moeen Ali slaps it towards point for a brace.
SIX! Up and over. Slightly shorter and just outside off, Moeen Ali lofts over long off for a maximum.
Leg bye! Sharp bounce by Barry McCarthy. Moeen Ali gets hit on the bicep and crosses over for a single.
WIDE! Barry McCarthy sprays this one down the leg side in his quest to follow the batter.
FOUR! Smart batting by Moeen Ali! Slower and a bit short outside off, Moeen Ali makes room and thumps this one over mid off for a much-needed boundary.
Bumper outside off, Moeen Ali sways away from the delivery and lets it go through to the keeper.
Full outside off, Liam Livingstone gets to the pitch of the ball and knocks it to mid off to open his account.
Short of a length delivery on off, Liam Livingstone gets an inside edge back onto his pads as he tried to work it on the off side.
Liam Livingstone is the new batter.

OUT! CAUGHT! Malan's struggle comes to end. Short and outside off, Malan shuffles across looking to thump this towards the leg side. Gets a thick outside edge that flies to Fionn Hand at third man who takes a fine catch running to his right and keeping his eyes on the ball till the last moment. England are now 5 down.
Commentary.Howout: c Fionn Hand b Barry McCarthy

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! No, he can't! Moeen Ali finds the boundary! 72 needed now from 42 balls! Bowls it fuller on off. Ali drills it down the ground away from long on for a boundary.
Shortish delivery, outside off. Malan cuts it to sweeper cover for a single. Five singles in the over, can Delany finish off well?
Ali skips down the track and drills this full delivery on off to long off for a single.
Delivers it outside off and flatter. Malan gets across to his left and sweeps it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Ali slog-sweeps it firmly to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Bowls a fullish delivery on off. Malan goes for the slog-sweep but gets it off the inside half of his blade to deep square leg for a single.
Short outside off, Dawid Malan rocks back and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Leg bye! Short and at the batter, Ali gets this one off his body behind square for a single.
WIDE! Short and sliding past the batter, Ali carefully lets it go through to the keeper.
Back of a length and on off, Dawid Malan flicks it to square leg for another single.
FOUR! LUCKY BOUNDARY! Another bumper outside off, Dawid Malan goes for the pull, gets an inside edge that goes to the left of fine leg for a much needed boundary.
Banged in short at the batter, Dawid Malan gets hurried on the pull and ends up hitting it back to the bowler.
Full and angling into the pads, Moeen Ali tucks it to fine leg for a single.
On off this time, Moeen Ali nudges it to mid-wicket for one.
Moeen Ali walks in.

OUT! CAUGHT! This time it is taken and Brook departs! Dockrell bowls it short and on off. Brook goes back and tries to pull it over the mid-wicket fence. However, the boudaries are bigger on that side and Brook fails to clear the fence as Delany in the deep takes a fine catch. England are under the pump here!
Commentary.Howout: c Gareth Delany b George Dockrell

Commentary.Commentary: Tad shorter and on middle. Malan works it behind square on the leg side for a single.
A flatter delivery on middle. Malan tries to sweep it but misses as the ball bounces and hits his arm on its way to the helmet.

Oh...another drop, this time a tougher chance but they need to take these chances. A fullish delivery, outside off. Malan slices it uppishly towards deep point where Delany runs forward and puts in a dive forward as well to take it but fails to catch it. Two taken this time.

PUT DOWN! George Dockrell bowls a shortish delivery on off. Brook goes back and mistimes his pull shot to long on. Adair there runs way too forward than he should have and ends up dropping it even though he gets both hands to it. Single taken.

Drinks! England are struggling a bit and they need a solid partnership from Malan and Brook if they need to win this one. Ireland have been good with the ball and they will hope to continue with the same momentum. England are currently 63 for 3 at the halfway mark. George Dockrell comes into the attack.
Full outside off, Harry Brook looks to slog this one down the ground, gets an outside edge that flies towards third man for a single.
Full on off, Harry Brook smartly shuffles across and nudges this one behind square and comes back for two. Good running by Harry Brook.
WIDE! Hand loses his radar again. Bangs this one way down the leg side and Brook lets it go.
Hand shortens his length and bowls this one outside off, Harry Brook defends it to backward point.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Half volley on off, Harry Brook holds his shape and lofts this one over mid off for a much needed boundary.
Full and shaping away on off, Harry Brook looks to defend this one and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Short on off, Dawid Malan does not get proper timing on the pull and mishits it to mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE Full delivery swinging into Malan but just too wide down the leg side as Malan misses his flick shot.
Couple of runs to end another tight over, 105 needed now from 66 balls! Delany angles it into middle. Brook uses the depth of the crease and works it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Just a single again! Delany is mixing up his pace nicely here. Bowls it quicker on middle. Malan nudges it to mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Bowls another googly but it is too wide outside off and Malan leaves it.
Tad shorter and on middle. Brook punches it to long on for a single.
A googly now turning into leg. Brook tries to pull it by getting low but misses and gets hit high on his pads.
A flatter one, on off. Brook goes back and plays it back to the bowler.
Tossed up, on middle. Brook skips down the track and works it towards the leg side.
Short of a length delivery on off, Harry Brook punches it to deep cover for a single.
Clever bowling by Barry McCarthy. Short and at the batter, Brook tries to ride the bounce of the delivery and roll his wrist but fails to make any contact.
Bumper outside off by Barry McCarthy, Malan gets hurried on the pull and mistimes it to mid-wicket for a single.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Dawid Malan gets beaten as he tried to slash the delivery.
WIDE! Back-of-a-length delivery sliding down the leg side. Malan lets it go.
Full and wide outside off, Dawid Malan gets an under edge through to the keeper as went for the drive.
Short on off, Harry Brook clips it off the backfoot to mid-wicket for a single.
Barry McCarthy is back on.
Nicely bowled! Fires in a googly, on middle. Brook works it to mid-wicket for a single. 114 needed now from 78 balls!
Shortish one and outside off. Malan cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Unlucky for Ireland but England will take it. Tossed up, around off. Malan tries to drive it but gets a thick outside edge that runs past short third man for a boundary.
On the pads this time and Brook clips it to short fine leg for a single.
Brook skips down the track and Delany pulls back his length a bit, on off. Brook only manages to push it towards covers.
Bowls a flatter delivery on middle. Brook works it towards the leg side.
Banged in short by Hand, Dawid Malan rocks back and pulls this one to the right of deep square leg for a couple of runs. England are 37 for 3 after the Powerplay.
Sliding onto the pads, Dawid Malan looks to help it behind square but the ball deflects off his pads for a couple of runs.
Good-length delivery on middle, Dawid Malan gets forward and defends this one.
WIDE! Hand fails to keep it within the stumps and sprays it down the leg side.
Short and wide outside off, Harry Brook stands tall and cuts this one over backward point. Josh Little runs around from third man and prevents the boundary.
Short and angling away from the batter, Brook pushes at it half-heartedly and gets beaten.

OUT! BOWLED! STOKES GONE! Fullish delivery swings in late to Stokes as he tries to drive it without much foot movement. The ball sneaks past the gap between bat and pad to rattle into the stumps. England are now 3 down inside the powerplay. Fionn Hand is pumped up and Irish after starting well with the bat in the first half, have started well with the ball as well.
Who will walk out now?
WIDE! Hand starts off with a loosener. Sprays it down the leg side. The keeper dives to his right and stops it.

Angling into middle as he hits the hard length. Stokes makes room to play it towards the off side but gets the inside edge that rolls towards the leg side. Malan calls for a quick run and they complete it easily.
Pulls his length back slightly this time, around off and Malan guides it to third man for a single.
Beaten again! Adair continues to bowl in that channel, outside off. Malan has a poke at it but misses it again.
Lovely delivery! Nice good-length delivery, around off. The ball seams off the pitch away from Malan as he tries to push it. Beats the outside edge of his blade.
Angles it into the pads and it is a slower delivery as well. Stokes tucks it towards square leg for a single.
On a length and around off. Malan steers it towards third man for a single.
Good-length delivery swings into the batter, Malan gets a thick outside edge that goes towards third man for a single.
WIDE! Barry McCarthy loses his radar as he sprays this one down the leg side. Malan lets it go.
Back-of-a-length delivery on leg, Ben Stokes works it off the backfoot to deep square leg for a single.
Full and outside off, Dawid Malan frees his arms and drives this one through the off side. The batters run three.
Fullish delivery nips back into Stokes. He shimmies down the track and works it to mid on for a single.
Full and swinging into the batter, Stokes nudges it behind square and gets off the mark with a brace.
Full and angling into the pads, Dawid Malan clips it to deep square leg for a single.
Another leave and another brilliant over from Little! He hits that good length again, outside off. Stokes decides to leave it.
Serves it on a good length and around off. Stokes leaves it alone.
Ben Stokes walks in.

OUT! CAUGHT! This time Hales is gone, big wicket and England are under pressure here! Little delivers a sharp short delivery. Hales tries to pull it. However, he gets a top edge and Mark Adair who is at short fine leg runs forward and to his left to take a fine catch. Can Ireland capitalise on this good start now?
Commentary.Howout: c Mark Adair b Josh Little

Commentary.Commentary: Oh, dropped! Short and outside off. Hales cuts it hard aerially towards point. Delany there is late to react and tries to take it with his right hand. Fails to grab it and two runs are taken.
Excellemt comeback from Little! Serves it on a good length, around off. Hales tries to punch it towards the off side but misses.
FOUR! Lovely from Hales! Back of a length, around off. Hales goes deep in his crease and brings out a short-arm jab. The ball runs away towards the mid-wicket fence.
Back of a length delivery going away from Malan. He pokes at it and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Beauty of a delivery! Good-length delivery nips back into Malan. Cuts the batter into half as the ball sails over the stumps.
Short and shaping away from the batter, Malan moves to the off side and pulls this one over mid on for a couple of runs.
Full and angling away from the batter, Malan shoulders arms and carefully lets it go.
Short and outside off, Alex Hales cuts it to deep point and gets off the mark with a single.
Full and shaping away outside off, Dawid Malan shuffles across and clubs this one over mid-on. The batters run three.
Mark Adair to bowl from the other end.
Single to end the over and a great start for Little and Ireland this. Back of a length, around leg. Malan tucks it towards the leg side and takes a single to get off the mark.
On a length again, on off. Malan defends it solidly from his crease.
Ohh..nice shape for Little! Serves it on a good length and around off. The ball swings first and then seams as well after pitching as Malan leaves it.
Lands it on a length, on off. Malan blocks it from his crease.
WIDE! A fullish delivery but it is too wide outside off, Malan leaves it.
Dawid Malan is the new batter.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Josh Little strikes and gets rid of the dangerous Jos Buttler straightaway! A dream start for the Irish this. A fullish delivery, around off. It is angled across the batter and Buttler tries to launch it down the ground. However, all he manages to do is to get an outside edge which carries to the keeper and Lorcan Tucker takes an easy catch behind the stumps. Game on, folks!
Commentary.Howout: c Lorcan Tucker b Josh Little

Commentary.Commentary: Josh Little starts with a shortish delivery, outside off. Buttler tries to cut it but misses. Little is key here for the Irish!
